'''Jynne Celwik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] prior to the [[Clone Wars|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she was working in the club, searching for big tippers and thirsty customers, on the [[Local day/Legends|night]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran into the club to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|hide]] from [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
Jynne Celwik was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] employed as a [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="jc" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE2" /> She worked at the club just prior to the start of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="jc" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Celwik was working at the club the [[Local day/Legends|night]] of the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|attempted assassination]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]],<ref name="EP2" /> roaming the floor in search big tippers and thirsty patrons.<ref name="Tip">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/imageattack/2003/04/imageattack20030415.html|series=Image Attack|text=Tip Your Waitresses}}</ref>

The assassin, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], ran into the club to hide while being chased by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Just as the Jedi entered the club, she serviced a table, later making rounds through the club as Skywalker surveyed the crowd. She poured a drink for a patron moments before Kenobi [[Dismemberment/Legends|sliced off]] Wesell's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at the bar of the club. While patrons of the club had their attention drawn to the altercation, Celwik did not turn to look and walked away from the table. Wesell was removed from the waitress's workplace shortly after.<ref name="EP2" />

==Personality and traits==
Celwik had curled [[Color/Legends|blonde]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and light skin.<ref name="jc" /> Her look while working at the club was considered attractive, yet unpretentious, unlike the patrons she served.<ref name=Who'sWho">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Celwik wore a black [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] and thigh-high black [[Boot/Legends|boots]] while working at the Outlander. She carried around a white tray.<ref name="EP2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jynne Celwik first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. The Outlander Club scenes including Celwik,<ref name="EP2">{{Film|II}}</ref> who was portrayed by uncredited model [[Kristen Bronson]],<ref name="Bronson">{{WebCite|url=https://kristenbronson.com/artwork/3258696-Star-Wars-Episode-2.html|text=TV/ +FILM|archivedate=20250316184213}}</ref> were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The character was first identified on [[April 15]], [[2003]] through the [[StarWars.com]] [[Image Attack]] feature.<ref name="Tip" />
